correctness.rationale: The domain is the product of independent negative target symbols and nonnegative source symbols. Direct inverse enumeration gives delta(x)=|tau^{-1}(x[-1])|; fixed-point enumeration gives coefficient [v^d] I=d times the number of target symbols of fiber size d. Any unrestricted conjugacy preserves inverse-image counts, so the coefficient profile is necessary; a pair of source/target alphabet bijections proves sufficiency. All partitions occur. Periodic coordinates are forced by one forward N-ary word, proving exact N^n and weighted sums. A zipper factor from the full bilateral shift and the future-coordinate factor give both entropy bounds; its inverse-limit lift is bijective. CHECKS.py tests all surjections for N<=6 and bounded period sums. No finite check is used to prove the infinite theorem.

originality.rationale: The searched founding zip-shift paper provides local-preimage analyses and examples but not an intrinsic fixed-point polynomial classifying unrestricted conjugacies of all full one-block surjections; related shadowing, measure-theoretic uniform-degree, and one-sided automorphism works do not state the same equivalence. Precise partition counts and degree-refined periodic zeta distinguish systems with identical conventional dynamics. Non-exhaustive priority uncertainty is documented.

The uniform-degree case and the invariance of inverse fiber cardinality are elementary known ingredients; originality rests on the complete equivalence, p(N) family and refined period comparison, not those ingredients alone.

value.rationale: The motivating 2025 zip-shift paper explicitly seeks classification of finite-to-one symbolic models and contrasts dynamics missed by one-sided codes. This result completely classifies a natural infinite family of nonconstant-degree examples under unrestricted topological conjugacies, gives exact class counts p(N), and exhibits the structural loss of information in entropy, periodic counts and natural extensions alongside a precise degree-refined recovery mechanism. It is not an arbitrary finite cutoff, a textbook isolated exercise, or just an application of a known degree-invariance observation.
